body.message:
This is completely unacceptable. Check-in time has already passed, yet the apartment is still in a chaotic condition and your cleaners are only now starting to clean it.

This is a serious breach of our booking agreement. I demand a full and immediate refund. If my refund is not processed without delay, I will report this matter to Dubai Tourist Police and the Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism, and I will also file a formal complaint with Booking.com.

Please confirm the full refund immediately.
